title: One landing page. One clear price.
body: A clear entry point instead of an open-ended agency quote: you know what you get and what it costs.

card.planDescription: For one offer, service, or campaign — from structure to launch.
items: 1 landing page with up to 6 sections

hint: €999 applies to exactly this scope. More sections, extra feedback rounds, or custom functionality are quoted transparently in advance — you decide before any costs are added.
